questionText: In the circuit shown below with a 12V battery, an internal resistance of 2Ω, and two external resistors of 4Ω and 6Ω connected in series, what is the total resistance in the circuit?
correctExplanation: The total resistance is the sum of the internal resistance and the total resistance of the external resistors, which are connected in series.
